# Security

Report vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/MohammedEsafi/tunnels/security/advisories/new),
not in a public issue. You will get an answer within a week; fixes ship as a
new release with a note in `CHANGELOG.md`.

How the app handles trust, and what to check in a security-sensitive change,
is in the [security](https://github.com/MohammedEsafi/tunnels/blob/main/.agents/skills/security/SKILL.md) skill.
